title: Data And Accounts: Backups, Logs & Domains

freshness.note: options reused from security-ready-3 (split, not new)

pairs.ask: Monthly Check Of Bank, Card And Broker Login Alerts: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: In the monthly review, check login alerts and new devices on bank, card and broker accounts. Who does it: You, With Security.

Who does it: You,</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">With Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: A new device on a money account can go unnoticed for weeks.

pairs.ask: Dropbox Version History And An Offline Copy: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Confirm version history is on and keep an offline copy of those three folders. Who does it: You, With Security.

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: The key Dropbox folders (01 Work, 02 Personal, 03 AI Resources) have no confirmed offline copy.

pairs.ask: Monthly Check For Decrypted Client Copies: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Each month Security checks the temp folders for decrypted client or tenant copies and deletes them. Who does it: Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Each month Security checks the temp</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">folders for decrypted client or tenant</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">copies and deletes them. Who does it:</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Decrypted Home Guide copies were found in temp folders and deleted. New ones can appear when agents test.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters:</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Decrypted Home Guide copies were found</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">in temp folders and deleted. New ones</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">can appear when agents test.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Check Email Records Before The DNS Move: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: UpKeep and you compare the imported records with the current ones before the nameserver change. Who does it: UpKeep And You.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">UpKeep and you compare the imported</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">records with the current ones before</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">the nameserver change. Who does it:</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">UpKeep And You.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Moving nameservers to Cloudflare can break email if the MX or TXT records are missed.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters:</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Moving nameservers to Cloudflare can</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">break email if the MX or TXT records</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">are missed.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Know The smartupkeep.ai Renewal Date: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Write down the renewal date and check it in the monthly review with the registrar lock. Who does it: You.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Write down the renewal date and check</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">it in the monthly review with the</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">registrar lock. Who does it: You.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: A missed domain renewal would take the site and its email down.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters: A</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">missed domain renewal would take the</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">site and its email down.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Consent Checkbox And Terms Link At Checkout: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Legal writes the wording, and UpKeep adds a consent checkbox with a terms link at checkout. Who does it: Legal, Then UpKeep.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Legal writes the wording, and UpKeep</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">adds a consent checkbox with a terms</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">link at checkout. Who does it: Legal,</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Then UpKeep.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: There is no consent step or cookie and analytics notice yet.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters:</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">There is no consent step or cookie and</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">analytics notice yet.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Tenant And Contract Folders Stay Restricted: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: The monthly review checks they are still restricted, or in the vault once it exists. Who does it: Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">The monthly review checks they are</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">still restricted, or in the vault once</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">it exists. Who does it: Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: The tenant and contract folders were restricted today and could be opened up again by mistake.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters: The</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">tenant and contract folders were</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">restricted today and could be opened</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">up again by mistake.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Second Backup On An Encrypted SSD: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Add an encrypted external SSD as a second copy alongside the cloud backup, refreshed once a month. Who does it: You, With Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Add an encrypted external SSD as a</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">second copy alongside the cloud</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">backup, refreshed once a month. Who</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">does it: You, With Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Two copies in two places means one bad account or one lost bag does not lose everything.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters: Two</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">copies in two places means one bad</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">account or one lost bag does not lose</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">everything.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Clear Out Old Unlocked Copies On The Shared Computer: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Delete leftover test copies on the shared computer (old walk-app and deck copies) that still hold unlocked pages. Who does it: Security, With Your OK.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Delete leftover test copies on the</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">shared computer (old walk-app and deck</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">copies) that still hold unlocked</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">pages. Who does it: Security, With</text><text x="18" y="168" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Your OK.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Old copies hold the unlocked text and the customer address, and any agent can read them.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters: Old</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">copies hold the unlocked text and the</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">customer address, and any agent can</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">read them.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Log Who Unlocks Pages On The Shared Computer: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Each time an agent runs the unlock tool, add one line (agent, site, time) to a log that Security reviews weekly. Who does it: Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Each time an agent runs the unlock</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">tool, add one line (agent, site, time)</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">to a log that Security reviews weekly.</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Who does it: Security.</text></svg>
